jobs.description:
Are you hands-on, quality-focused, and looking for a stable production job? Then this opportunity could be a great fit for you!

You will help produce high-quality safety boots used in industries such as agriculture, food production, construction, and fishing.
Your Responsibilities
• Assemble components onto moulds before production
• Operate production machines together with a colleague
• Remove finished boots from the machine
• Clean and prepare machines for the next production cycle
• Trim and finish products by removing excess material
• Carry out detailed quality inspections
• Ensure every product meets the required quality standards

Your Profile

• Experience in a production environment is an advantage
• You are willing to learn and develop new skills
• You work accurately and have a strong eye for detail
• Quality is your top priority
• You enjoy working closely with colleagues and supporting the team
• You have your own transportation
• You speak English or Dutch and English (you are able to follow training and work instructions in English)Working Environment
• Modern manufacturing environment
• Standing work throughout most of the shift
• Team-oriented workplace with colleagues from different nationalities (Polish, Ukrainian, Hungarian etc)
• Production targets are important, but quality always comes first
• Product inspection and quality control are a key part of the job

We are looking for a Machine Operator (Carpentry) for a company that specializes in making caskets!

What will your responsibilities be?

• Planing and sawing products
• Operating the gluing machine
• Conducting quality checks on products
• Operating a forklift
Work hours: 12:30 p.m. – 8:00 p.m.

Who are you?

• You’re open to physical work
• Forklift experience or a certificate is a plus
• You speak Dutch, English, or Polish
• You’re open to working a fixed afternoon shift
• You have your own transportation

• After thorough training by an experienced colleague, you will independently perform cutting and bending operations.
• You will calculate flat patterns and program the sheet metal processing machines.
• Using technical drawings, you will learn to independently carry out various metalworking operations such as bending, cutting, deburring, tapping, and other machining processes on workpieces.

• You have an A2 degree in Mechanics or equivalent experience.
• You have knowledge of a guillotine shear, press brake, corner notcher, and punching machine.
• You can read and interpret technical drawings.
• Good spatial insight is essential.
• You work accurately and can work independently after the training period.
• Order, cleanliness, and safety are second nature to you.
• English or Dutch.

Are you a handy jack-of-all-rounder with a passion for maintenance? Then I’m looking for you!

For a company in Aalter that specializes in structural steel, I’m looking for a motivated Maintenance Technician!

What will your responsibilities be?

• You’ll perform preventive and corrective maintenance on pneumatic, mechanical, and hydraulic systems.
• You’ll thoroughly troubleshoot and resolve malfunctions in machines and systems.
• You’ll work in a technical team where everyone is committed to optimization.
• You’ll strictly adhere to safety regulations.
• You’ll conduct quality checks.

Who are you?

• You have a technical mindset! This is reflected in your experience or technical training.
• You preferably have knowledge of pneumatic, hydraulic, and/or mechanical systems.
• You have experience with preventive maintenance.
• You are passionate about troubleshooting and resolving issues.
• You speak English or Dutch.
• Polish or Romanian is a plus!

jobs.occupation: Line Leader Slicing - Meat Company | Oudenaarde | 2 Shifts
jobs.description:
For a growing food production company in Oudenaarde, we are looking for a Line Leader Slicing. The company specializes in slicing and packaging ham products for various supermarket chains.

As a Line Leader, you will be responsible for the smooth operation of the slicing line. You will coordinate the production process, support and supervise operators, ensure product quality, and make sure all hygiene and safety standards are respected.

Your Responsibilities

• Leading and supporting employees on the slicing line.
• Setting up, monitoring, and adjusting production machines.
• Ensuring product quality and correct packaging.
• Solving minor machine issues and reporting technical problems.
• Monitoring compliance with hygiene, quality, and safety regulations.
• Following up on production targets and reporting results.
The job is not physically demanding!

Early shift: 5:00 a.m.–1:30 p.m.

Late shift: 1:30 p.m.–10:00 p.m.

You get a half-hour break.

Profile

• Previous experience in a production environment is required, preferably within the food industry.
• Experience as a team leader, supervisor, or line leader is an advantage.
• You are detail-oriented and quality-focused.
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system.
• You have good communication and leadership skills.
• You will speak in English, Polish or Ukrainian with your colleagues

We are looking for an experienced and motivated crane operator to join our team. You will work in a 2-shift system and handle heavy loads safely and efficiently.

Your tasks:

• 
Operate overhead cranes and semi-portal cranes (up to 25 tons)

• 
Perform visual inspections and basic maintenance

• 
Follow safety rules at all times

• 
Work closely with your team to move materials

• 
Keep records of movements and incidents

Your profile:

• 
Experience with cranes, forklifts, or tower cranes

• 
A valid certificate is a plus (can also be obtained internally)

• 
Good technical skills and understanding of safety rules

• 
Willing to work in two shifts (early: 5:00-13:15 / late: 13:15-21:30)

• 
Team player, flexible, precise, and stress-resistant

• 
Good understanding of balance and load distribution

• 
Good Dutch or English skills

We are looking for a technically minded operator who enjoys practical work and wants to learn new things. You will operate and monitor various advanced machines:

• Tricantors: Separating oil from other materials – high-quality machines that require a delicate touch to operate.
• Shredder: Reducing the size of filter cloths.
• Vogelsang installation: Technical installations that require precision and attention
In addition, you will remain calm and focused when problems arise while multiple machines are running.

Working environment

• Greasy environment – work clothes and boots get dirty and smell of frying oil.
• Hands-on mentality required.
• Willingness to work the night shift.
Working hours

Monday - Friday: 08:00 PM - 04:00 AM

Profile

• You're not afraid to get your hands dirty
• Technical profile is compulsory
• Good knowledge of Dutch, French or English
• Experience as operator or higher education is a plus
• Experience operating Manitou and Komatsu cranes is a plus
• A stable CV

For a company in the Waregem area, I am looking for a polyvalent forklift driver.

Tasks:

• Operating gasoline-powered forklifts.
• Performing tasks without a forklift, such as hosing down trucks and containers.
• Working around live chickens.

• You have a lot of experience with a forklift.
• You are in possession of a valid forklift certificate.
• You are flexible in hours. You start at 5am, but end times varies.
• You want to work in the area of chickens
• We can count on you 
• You can speak sufficient English. French is a plus.

Looking for a motivated Electrical Mechanic in Gent! 
Your tasks?

• Maintenance of electrical and mechanical systems.
• Troubleshooting and repairing machine malfunctions.
• Assembling, adjusting, and testing equipment.
• Performing preventive maintenance to avoid breakdowns

Who are you? 

• You have knowledge on at least one of the following topics: 
• PLC
• Elektricity
• Hydraulics
• Pneumatics
• You speak English well
• You have your own transport

For a company in the meat industry Oudenaarde, we are looking for an All-round Technician.

What will your responsibilities be?

• You will be responsible for corrective, preventive and improvement-oriented maintenance of the machinery, equipment and buildings.

• You will carry out scheduled maintenance and perform the necessary repairs.

• You will ensure the production machinery operates optimal.

Who are you?

• You are able to identify and resolve technical faults.

• You have a good command of either Dutch or English.

For a company in the meat industry Oudenaarde, we are looking for an All-round Technician.

Do you have a passion for technology and are you looking for a challenging job with responsibility?
Become a bending machine operator in an innovative production environment! You'll bend pipes of various sizes, cut them to length where needed, and remove burrs. The work can be physically demanding, especially with larger pipes. Experience in the metal industry is a strong plus.

What are you tasks?

• 
Operate and set up the bending machine to ensure precise pipe shaping.

• 
Monitor the process and intervene in case of malfunctions to guarantee a perfect end product.

• 
2-shift system!

Dutch and/or English language skills are required.

Your profile:

• 
You have technical knowledge or experience in a similar role.

• 
Accuracy and attention to detail are your strong suits.

• 
You are eager to learn and interested in automation and production processes.

• 
You can work independently, but also thrive in a team environment.

• 
Safety and quality are always your top priorities.

Location: Kluisbergen
Industry: Rubber Manufacturing
Work Schedule: 2 shifts (early & late)
About the Company
We are a well-established rubber manufacturing company based in Kluisbergen, specialized in the production of high-quality rubber products for various industrial applications. Due to continued growth, we are looking for a motivated Production Operator to strengthen our team.
Your Responsibilities
• 
Operating and monitoring production machines

• 
Setting up machines according to production parameters

• 
Performing quality checks on finished products

• 
Identifying and reporting technical or production issues

• 
Ensuring a safe, clean, and organized working environment

• 
Working closely with colleagues and supervisors to meet production targets

• 
You have first experience as an operator in a production environment

• 
Technical insight and willingness to learn

• 
Ability to work accurately and independently

• 
Good understanding of safety and quality standards

• 
You are flexible and willing to work in a 2-shift system

• 
Good knowledge of English (Dutch is a plus)

Ready to take charge of your own CNC machine and produce high-quality parts?

Your Responsibilities:

• Inspect and adjust first pieces as needed
• Move large workpieces using an overhead crane (certification is a plus, training can be provided internally)
• Work on a fixed machine and fully utilize your expertise
• Program directly at the machine
• Independently produce hydraulic components on CNC machines
• Read technical drawings and determine the optimal workflow

Your Profile:

• Read technical drawings and plan the machining sequence
• Experience with overhead cranes or willingness to learn
• Strict adherence to safety regulations
• Precise and skilled with measuring tools
• Able to program and set up machines independently
• Good knowledge of Dutch, French, or English
• Experience as a CNC milling operator or machinist

Do you have a technical mindset?Are you passionate about machines and technology? Do you live near Waregem? 
Then this opportunity is for you!

For a leading company specialized in certified labels, we are looking for a Technical Operator in 2 Shifts or a Fixed Morning Shift!

What are your tasks?

• Operating complex machines on the production line
• Setting temperatures
• Setting parameters
• Filling machines with very precise quantities of materials
• Adhering to strict safety regulations

Who are you?

• You have a strong technical background, gained through education or work experience. 
• You speak Nederlands or English.

Do you enjoy physical work and don't mind working in a cold environment? Are you comfortable working in the meat industry (pork)? Then this opportunity could be perfect for you!

For our client’s deboning department, we are looking for a motivated employee with experience as a butcher, meat deboner, or within the meat processing industry.

Your Profile

• Experience as a butcher, deboner, or within the meat industry is a strong asset.
• You are motivated and enjoy hands-on work.
• You preferably speak and understand at least two of the following languages: Dutch, English, or Polish.
• If you speak one of these languages well, you are also welcome to apply.

Your Responsibilities

• Working according to quality, hygiene, and safety standards.
• Cooperating with colleagues in a production environment.

We are urgently looking for people who can support our client in Zottegem. 

If you know how to tackle things, read on further! 

What are our expectations?
